revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - can be entered as a PN correction credited to Clarysse. Note the correct initial reading

Vote - AcceptText - The new reading is correct but has been anticipated in Trismegistos by Clarysse; see https://www.trismegistos.org/ref/detail.php?ref_id=454194 ("reading W. Clarysse"; "Ἀκῦρις" in the heading, but Ἀβοῦρις further down) and https://www.trismegistos.org/text/4021#people. Note also that the original reading is Ἀκῦρις, not Ἀκοῦρις.

Submit - In TM NamVar 7916 it can be read that the name Ἀβοῦρις also occur in BGU XIV 2425, where it should have been mispelled in Ἀκοῦρις. In fact, according to the photograph, the reading Ἀβοῦρις seems itself preferable. I do not know where (and if) Clarysse already proposed this correction (cf. https://www.trismegistos.org/ref/detail.php?ref_id=454194&region=Egypt)
Commit - According to the photograph (https://berlpap.smb.museum/Original/P_16275_R_001.jpg), the reading Ἀβοῦρις is better than Ἀκοῦρις
